metaDescription: Order branded silver pedometers for corporate wellness programs. Custom imprint available. Shop Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Silver pedometers offer a sleek, neutral look that blends seamlessly with professional attire, making them ideal for corporate wellness initiatives and employee step challenges. The metallic finish resists fingerprints and scuffs better than darker colors, keeping your logo visible over time. Choose from clip-on or lanyard styles, and add your company name or program slogan with a single-color imprint for a clean, polished appearance.
heroAltText: Custom silver pedometer with step display and clip, personalized with company logo for corporate wellness programs.
